items.title: Trump willing to pardon Jensen Huang, says it won’t be necessary
items.content: The president’s remarks come days before Jensen Huang is due to face congressional questioning over national security concerns and US chip export controls.

items.title: CleanSpark weighs selling more Bitcoin than it mines to de-risk books
items.content: The Bitcoin miner sold 2,102 BTC while it produced just 1,708 BTC in the September quarter.

items.title: Hackers breach CIA intelligence network in latest US cyberattack
items.content: The reported breach follows cyber incidents involving the FBI, Department of Homeland Security and Department of Agriculture.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
items.content: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.

items.title: Utah moves to dismiss criminal charges against Kalshi after trading halt
items.content: Utah’s attorney general warned that the criminal charges could be refiled if Kalshi resumes operations in the state, while separate civil litigation remains unresolved.

items.title: Bitcoin sell-off driven by weak demand, forced liquidations: 21Shares
items.content: The crypto asset manager warned that Bitcoin’s downturn could persist amid weak investor demand, while forecasting an uneven recovery across crypto sectors.

items.title: Coldcard reveals how Bitcoin wallet flaw went undetected for over 5 years
items.content: Coldcard maker Coinkite explained why years of security checks failed to catch the flaw and said it has yet to decide on compensation for affected customers.

items.title: CFTC sets new prediction market rules as more firms seek US entry
items.content: The US regulator has approved permanent reporting rules for certain event contracts as more companies look to launch prediction markets.

items.title: BlackRock launches tokenized money market fund accepting stablecoins in Hong Kong
items.content: The tokenized fund launched with approximately $100 million in assets, with Standard Chartered and Ant International participating as seed investors.

items.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
items.content: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.

items.title: How South Korea’s proposed 20% cap could change who runs Upbit
items.content: Naver Financial agreed to buy every share in Upbit’s operator, but a proposed ownership cap could strip away its voting rights on four-fifths of them.

items.title: USDT buyers face 22% VAT when Moscow Exchange opens crypto trading
items.content: Buyers will pay VAT on top of the trade price in December because Russia’s tax code has no explicit exemption for foreign digital instruments.

items.title: Swiss central bank, UBS and SIX study ledger for tokenized settlement
items.content: The study will assess whether a shared ledger can bring central bank money, commercial bank money and securities onto the same platform.

items.title: Sky lender proposes buyback of up to $50M to fund stUSDS withdrawals
items.content: Borrowers would sell SKY to the protocol and use the proceeds to pay down their loans, freeing up funds for depositors in the stUSDS pool.

items.title: Grayscale calls Bitcoin ‘oversold’ at $62K but warns of AI risks
items.content: Grayscale said Bitcoin’s bear market was its longest on record at 411 days and counting, though the 56% drop was the smallest percentage decline.

items.title: South Korea proposes bank-led stablecoins, 20% cap on crypto exchange stakes
items.content: The draft bill would also reopen domestic initial coin offerings after a ban dating to 2017 and require issuers to disclose risks before soliciting buyers.

items.title: Bitcoin dipped on Huang’s Nvidia exit but jumped 5% on his return
items.content: Bitcoin rose about 5% on Jensen Huang’s return, more than the 3.5% it lost on news of his exit, but remained 19.2% below its pre-resignation price.

items.title: Bitcoin dips back under $60K as gold seals worst 60-day loss since 1980s
items.content: Bitcoin continued to threaten the loss of $60,000 support as gold attempted to bounce from a 60-day losing streak during which it fell nearly 25%.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs keep bleeding as BlackRock’s IBIT shares gain nearly 5%
items.content: BlackRock’s IBIT shares gained 4.85% on Monday despite continued Bitcoin ETF withdrawals that pushed November’s net outflows to $4.71 billion.

items.title: Why 42 Macro says it’s waiting to buy the Bitcoin dip
items.content: The independent macro research company warns the Bitcoin sell-off may not have yet run its course.

items.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
items.content: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
items.content: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

items.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
items.content: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

items.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
items.content: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

items.title: Kalshi secures temporary win in New York gambling law dispute
items.content: The ruling allows Kalshi to continue operating as its legal battle with New York over sports-related event contracts moves toward a January hearing.

items.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
items.content: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

items.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
items.content: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

items.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
items.content: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
items.content: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.
